wireless
when shutdown the hid data
HID Data: 020000
before shutdown sleep 020000 data is send
HID Data: 0100000000000000

when sleep
HID Data: 0400010164000300000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000

when active
HID Data: 0401000164000300000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000

when active + charging
HID Data: 0401000264010700000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000

for example
HID Data: 04 01 00 02 64 01 07 00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
04 : header
01 : 00 not active, 01 is active
02 : dpi stage preset or config 0 to 5
02 : poling rate
64 : battery hex to decimal soo 64 is 100 or this case 100%
01 : 00 not charging, 01 is charging
07 : led mode

wired
2 type of data
HID Data: 00010000000000
HID Data: 0401010864010300000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000

HID Data: 04 01 01 08 64 01 03 00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
04 : header
01 : 00 not active, 01 is active
01 : dpi stage preset or config 0 to 5
08 : poling rate
64 : battery hex to decimal soo 64 is 100 or this case 100%
01 : 00 not charging, 01 is charging, 02 is full
03 : led mode

led mode
00 : none
01 : colorful streaming
02 : breathing
03 : steady
04 : neon
05 : snake
06 : colorfull steady
07 : wave

poling rate
08 : 125 hz
04 : 250 hz
02 : 500 hz
01 : 1000 hz
